Ivy (PM): Quick sync — Acme pilot wants model-level caching plus HSM compatibility. Need to lock sequencing across runtime/infra/security. Customer wants pilot by EOW month. Who owns deploy order and minimal scope?

Samir (Eng): Runtime work: KV cache eviction strategy, variant routing to quantized model, and a simple opt-in canary. Est: 3w dev + 1w validation. Blocking: infra KMS decision + ops plan.

Jonah (Runtime): Yup. Also need pinned model variants and canary fallback. Prefetch/batching changes could complicate rollout; recommend feature-flag-only for initial pilot.

Priya (Infra): Heads up: hosted KMS is straightforward; customer-managed HSM adds ~4w (procurement + ops onboarding). VPC peering and network review add a few days for on-prem. Need Acme to confirm hard requirement.

Eli (Security): I'll start threat modelling. Critical: keys must remain under customer control if they insist on HSM. If we use hosted KMS with customer CMK, we need a design doc and key access pattern. Share dataflow diagram pls.

Ivy (PM): Proposed sequence: 1) runtime changes (Samir/Jonah), 2) infra KMS choice (Priya), 3) security signoff (Eli), 4) SRE canary/rollout (Nina). If HSM optional -> soft-launch ~5w. If HSM required -> ~9w. Thoughts?

Samir (Eng): 5w is aggressive but doable if we freeze scope: only routing + eviction. No batching changes. Need two dedicated sprints and regression harness. I'll block cycles.

Jonah (Runtime): I'll spin a canary prototype today. Canary plan: 10% traffic -> if errors or latency regressions, auto-fallback to baseline model. Need SRE automation to orchestrate traffic weights and KV warmup.

Nina (SRE): We can run canary. Need a runbook with alert thresholds: latency P95 > 200ms, error rate > 1% for 5m window. We'll staff oncall for first 24h. Also need metrics emitted by runtime for KV hit rate and evictions.

Priya (Infra): Decision point: if Acme agrees to hosted KMS + customer CMK, we can hit pilot. If they insist on HSM, procurement lead is Hans; he'll need PO and contract. Ivy, can you confirm with Acme today?

Ivy (PM): Reaching out now. Acme said HSM is "preferred" but not required for pilot. I'll push them to accept hosted KMS for pilot and escalate if needed. Will update within 24h.

Eli (Security): Starting checklist: append design doc, anonymized dataset, expected key lifecycle, and any header changes. Also need to validate audit log path and access controls.

Samir (Eng): Adding CI plan: small CLI `/deploy canary --percent 10 --model X` plus smoke tests that exercise both routes and assert fallback behavior. Need infra flag for routing.

Jonah (Runtime): Created ticket ROUTE-642: "variant routing + canary support". Target PR by Fri EOD.

Ivy (PM): Quick action recap: Ivy confirm HSM preference (24h), Samir/Jonah deliver dev plan & timeline, Priya confirm procurement lead times + fallback, Eli produce security checklist, Nina draft runbook & alerting. Sync: Friday 10:00am. :thumbsup:
